pages.quiz:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When you ask a question in French, what should your voice do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Become louder only
   B. Go down
   C. Go up
   D. Stay silent

2. Fill in: Le livre est ______ la table. (on) (1 mark)
   A. dans
   B. entre
   C. sous
   D. sur

3. What does 'le salon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the living room
   B. the table
   C. the TV
   D. the chair

4. What does 'devant' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in front of
   B. in
   C. between
   D. on

5. How do you say 'On Sunday, I rest.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   B. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   C. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   D. Le vendredi, je danse.

6. Which month is 'juillet'? (1 mark)
   A. May
   B. July
   C. March
   D. October

7. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: How old is Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. eleven
   B. twelve
   C. nine
   D. ten

8. How do you say 'My birthday is on 12 May.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   B. J'ai dix ans.
   C. Voici un cadeau pour toi.
   D. Joyeux anniversaire !

9. Fill in: Ce sont ______ mangues. (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. une
   C. des
   D. un

10. What does 'le jus' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. milk
   B. the mango
   C. beans
   D. juice

11. What does 'Il fait froid.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is cloudy.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is cold.
   D. The weather is nice.

12. What does 'beaucoup' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a lot
   B. It is raining.
   C. the snow
   D. It is cold.

13. What does 'la pluie' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the weather
   B. the cloud
   C. the rain
   D. the snow

14. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: What does Kamau mean by De rien? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. You are welcome
   C. Excuse me
   D. Good morning

15. Which little word goes with 'grand-père' (the grandfather)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

16. Which little word goes with 'sœur' (the sister)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

17. Which little word goes with 'salon' (the living room)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. la

18. Which little word goes with 'télé' (the TV)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. le
   D. l'

19. Fill in: Le sac est ______ la chambre. (in) (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. sur
   C. sous
   D. dans

20. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: What does he do on Saturday? (1 mark)
   A. He sings.
   B. He goes to church.
   C. He plays football.
   D. He goes to school.

21. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: Who does he go to church with on Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. his family
   B. nobody
   C. his teacher
   D. his cat

22. What does 'Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   B. I am ten years old.
   C. How old are you?
   D. Happy birthday!

23. What does 'C'est bon pour la santé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   B. It is good for your health.
   C. I like milk.
   D. They are oranges.

24. What does 'J'ai deux pieds.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two ears.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. I have ten fingers.
   D. I have two feet.

25. What does 'Il a les cheveux courts.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have ten fingers.
   B. He has short hair.
   C. I have a mouth.
   D. I have two hands.

26. What does 'Touche ton nez !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have ten fingers.
   B. Touch your nose!
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I have two feet.

27. How do you say 'Mrs, Madam' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Madame
   B. merci
   C. non
   D. Monsieur

28. Fill in: Dans la cuisine, il y a un ______. (1 mark)
   A. lit
   B. canapé
   C. frigo
   D. tapis

29. How do you say 'the cat' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le livre
   B. la cuisine
   C. le chat
   D. la porte

30. How do you say the month 'May' in French? (1 mark)
   A. avril
   B. mai
   C. juillet
   D. septembre

31. How do you write the number 18 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. dix-huit
   C. deux
   D. douze

32. How do you say 'a song' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un cadeau
   B. un anniversaire
   C. une chanson
   D. une bougie

33. How do you say 'vegetables' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les légumes
   B. les bonbons
   C. les haricots
   D. le riz

34. How do you say 'the tomato' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. la tomate
   C. la santé
   D. les frites

35. How do you say 'the tooth' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la dent
   B. les cheveux
   C. la main
   D. le cou

36. How do you say 'tall, big' in French? (1 mark)
   A. noir
   B. grand
   C. court
   D. long

37. How do you say 'the foot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. le bras
   C. la bouche
   D. le genou

38. How do you say 'the rain' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'orage
   B. la pluie
   C. le temps
   D. le nuage

39. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'pleasant'? (1 mark)
   A. agreable
   B. agrèable
   C. agréable
   D. agréble

40. How do you say 'Go' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi
   B. De rien
   C. Allez
   D. Tournez

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'I sing and I dance.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'She has long hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Write the French words for: hi, bye, no, Sir, Mr (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Le livre est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'Hi, Kamau!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I play.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'They are oranges.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Write yesterday, today and tomorrow in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'It is cold.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Sort five foods into good for health and eat little, in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'And you?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

53. Write the French words for: maize, vegetables, juice (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into French: 'Good evening, Madam!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Write the French words for: straight ahead, Excuse me, Go (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'Goodbye, Sir.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'It is hot.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Translate into French: 'It is a table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'I drink a juice.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'The cat is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Translate into French: 'Here is my house.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Go up
   A question ends with a rising voice.

2. D — sur
   Sur means on.

3. A — the living room
   le salon means the living room.

4. A — in front of
   devant means in front of.

5. B — Le dimanche, je me repose.
   On Sunday, I rest. in French is Le dimanche, je me repose.

6. B — July
   juillet means July.

7. D — ten
   J'ai dix ans.

8. A — Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   My birthday is on 12 May. in French is Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.

9. C — des
   Des is used for many things.

10. D — juice
   le jus means juice.

11. C — It is cold.
   Il fait froid. means It is cold..

12. A — a lot
   beaucoup means a lot.

13. C — the rain
   la pluie means the rain.

14. B — You are welcome
   De rien answers merci.

15. D — le
   grand-père is masculine, so we say le grand-père.

16. B — la
   sœur is feminine, so we say la sœur.

17. A — le
   salon is masculine, so we say le salon.

18. A — la
   télé is feminine, so we say la télé.

19. D — dans
   Dans means in.

20. C — He plays football.
   Le samedi, je joue au football.

21. A — his family
   Avec ma famille means with my family.

22. A — There is a cake and there are balloons.
   Il y a un gâteau et des ballons. means There is a cake and there are balloons.

23. B — It is good for your health.
   C'est bon pour la santé. means It is good for your health.

24. D — I have two feet.
   J'ai deux pieds. means I have two feet.

25. B — He has short hair.
   Il a les cheveux courts. means He has short hair.

26. B — Touch your nose!
   Touche ton nez ! means Touch your nose!

27. A — Madame
   Mrs, Madam in French is Madame.

28. C — frigo
   A fridge belongs in the kitchen.

29. C — le chat
   the cat in French is le chat.

30. B — mai
   May in French is mai.

31. B — dix-huit
   18 in French is dix-huit.

32. C — une chanson
   a song in French is une chanson.

33. A — les légumes
   vegetables in French is les légumes.

34. B — la tomate
   the tomato in French is la tomate.

35. A — la dent
   the tooth in French is la dent.

36. B — grand
   tall, big in French is grand.

37. A — le pied
   the foot in French is le pied.

38. B — la pluie
   the rain in French is la pluie.

39. C — agréable
   The correct spelling is agréable, with its accents.

40. C — Allez
   Go in French is Allez.
